tools.name: lookup_wheel_fitment
tools.description: Bolt pattern (PCD), center bore, factory wheel size and offset, plus reference flush and maximum aftermarket wheel sizes for a vehicle. Give at least a make or model; add year to narrow results.

tools.name: vehicles_by_bolt_pattern
tools.description: List vehicles that use a given bolt pattern, e.g. 5x114.3 or 6x139.7. Useful to check which cars a wheel will bolt onto.

tools.name: list_makes
tools.description: All vehicle makes in the ANKUSI Wheel Fitment Dataset with the number of vehicles for each.
